value.signature: fn compare_header (input : & [u8] , expected : & HeaderParts) -> Result < () , EncodingError >

review.body: { let actual = decode_header (input) ? ; profile :: compare_body (& actual . parts . body , & expected . body) . map_err (| cause | { if cause == profile :: ProfileError :: Body { EncodingError :: Body } else { EncodingError :: Profile (cause) } }) ? ; if actual . parts . commitments . proposal != expected . commitments . proposal { return Err (EncodingError :: Proposal) ; } if actual . parts . commitments . content != expected . commitments . content { return Err (EncodingError :: Content) ; } if actual . parts . commitments . dependency != expected . commitments . dependency { return Err (EncodingError :: Dependency) ; } if actual . parts . actor_signature != expected . actor_signature { return Err (EncodingError :: ActorSignature) ; } if actual . parts . content_edition != expected . content_edition { return Err (EncodingError :: ContentEdition) ; } if actual . parts . dependency_edition != expected . dependency_edition { return Err (EncodingError :: DependencyEdition) ; } compare_header_bytes (input , & encode_header (expected) ? . bytes) }
